skill.name: canvas-design
skill.description: Create original static artwork and design philosophies, then export polished PNG or PDF compositions with minimal text and curated typography.
skill.summary: Turn a creative brief into an original visual philosophy and polished static artwork.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: All 27 font-license alerts are false positives caused by standard SIL Open Font License termination text. The remaining six static alerts point to Markdown prose and contain no executable shell or reconnaissance behavior. Semantic review found a high-severity fabricated-user instruction and a medium-severity unrestricted font-download directive.

remediation.issue: The skill falsely claims the user already demanded a pristine masterpiece.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the fabricated quotation and present refinement as an optional goal that remains subordinate to the actual user request.

remediation.issue: The skill permits downloading any fonts without source or integrity controls.
remediation.suggestion: Use bundled fonts by default. Require explicit approval, trusted HTTPS sources, license review, and integrity validation before downloading another font.

content.value_statement: Creative briefs often lack a coherent visual system for polished static artwork. This skill develops an original design philosophy and applies it to PNG or PDF compositions.
actual_capabilities: Writes a four-to-six paragraph visual philosophy in Markdown.
Creates a highly visual single-page PNG or PDF composition.
Selects typography from a bundled collection of design-focused fonts.
Uses color, form, spacing, rhythm, and hierarchy to express a concept.
Performs a second refinement pass for alignment, spacing, and visual cohesion.
Creates related multi-page artwork when the user requests a series.
limitations: Produces only Markdown, PNG, and PDF deliverables.
Favors sparse text and is not suitable for text-heavy documents.
Defaults to one page unless the request explicitly asks for more.
External font downloads can add security, licensing, and availability dependencies.

use_cases.title: Develop Campaign Artwork
use_cases.description: Create an original poster system with controlled typography, color, and hierarchy for a focused campaign.

use_cases.title: Explore Visual Directions
use_cases.description: Turn an early concept into a written design philosophy and a polished visual study.

use_cases.title: Build Editorial Art
use_cases.description: Produce a single-page or multi-page visual sequence with consistent aesthetic principles and subtle thematic references.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an original poster about [topic]. Use [colors], minimal text, clear margins, and a polished single-page PNG.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused static design

prompt_templates.title: Define a Visual Philosophy
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a visual philosophy for [theme], then create a PDF using [mood], [palette], geometric forms, and restrained typography.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate exploration of a coherent aesthetic system

prompt_templates.title: Embed a Subtle Reference
prompt_templates.prompt: Create artwork about [subject] with a subtle reference to [reference]. Communicate through composition, pattern, color, and sparse labels.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced conceptual artwork for a knowledgeable audience

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Page Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [page count] related pages for [project]. Maintain one philosophy while varying rhythm, scale, imagery, and typographic emphasis across pages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced art direction for a cohesive visual sequence

output_examples.input: Create an exhibition poster about urban memory using charcoal, white, and red.
output_examples.output: A four-paragraph philosophy titled Residual Grid, followed by a single-page PNG with layered marks, sparse labels, and controlled red accents.

output_examples.input: Design a quiet album cover inspired by tidal cycles without showing an ocean.
output_examples.output: A restrained PDF using repeated arcs, measured spacing, a limited palette, and minimal typography to suggest cyclical movement.

output_examples.input: Create three related pages for a small architecture publication.
output_examples.output: A three-page PDF series with consistent typography and margins, plus distinct geometric compositions that progress across the sequence.

best_practices: Provide the subject, audience, output format, dimensions, and required text.
Describe desired mood and constraints without requesting imitation of a living artist.
Review text accuracy, margins, font licensing, and output dimensions before publication.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for reports, manuals, or other text-heavy documents.
Do not request exact copies of protected artwork or a specific artist style.
Do not download unverified fonts when the bundled collection meets the brief.

faq.question: Which output formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It produces a Markdown design philosophy and final artwork as PNG or PDF.

faq.question: Can it create more than one page?
faq.answer: Yes. Request a page count and explain how the sequence should develop.

faq.question: Can it copy a specific artist style?
faq.answer: No. It should create original work from high-level visual qualities without copying protected expression.

faq.question: Are fonts included?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes a broad font collection that should be preferred over external downloads.

faq.question: Is it suitable for text-heavy layouts?
faq.answer: No. The workflow prioritizes visual communication and sparse, essential text.

faq.question: Does the output still need review?
faq.answer: Yes. Review typography, margins, factual text, licensing, and export quality before publishing.
